requirements.description: Customers search the catalogue and see only products whose name matches the keyword.
Adding a product with a quantity updates the cart item count and price.
A valid promo code applies its discount and an invalid code is rejected.
Orders are placed only after a country is chosen and terms are accepted.

testCases.title: Search shows only products matching the keyword
preconditions: GreenKart home page is open with the full catalogue

steps.action: Type the keyword into the search box

testCases.expectedResult: Only the expected products are listed; matching is case-insensitive.

testCases.title: Search without matches shows the empty-state message
testCases.expectedResult: No products are listed and 'Sorry, no products matched your search!' is displayed.

testCases.title: Adding a product with quantity updates the cart summary
preconditions: GreenKart home page is open with an empty cart
testCases.expectedResult: Cart header shows 1 item and a price of unit price × 3.

testCases.title: Valid promo code applies a 10% discount
preconditions: Cart contains Tomato × 3 and the cart page is open
testCases.expectedResult: Discount shows 10% and total after discount equals 90% of the total amount.

testCases.title: Invalid promo code is rejected and no discount is applied
preconditions: Cart contains a product and the cart page is open

steps.action: Enter an invalid promo code and click Apply

testCases.expectedResult: 'Invalid code ..!' is shown and the discount remains 0%.

testCases.title: Proceeding without accepting terms shows a mandatory error
preconditions: An order has been placed from the cart and the country page is open

steps.action: Click Proceed without accepting the terms

testCases.expectedResult: 'Please accept Terms & Conditions - Required' is displayed.

testCases.title: Customer places an order end to end
preconditions: GreenKart home page is open with an empty cart

steps.action: Open the cart and click PROCEED TO CHECKOUT
Select India, accept the terms and click Proceed

testCases.expectedResult: 'Thank you, your order has been placed successfully' is displayed.

testCases.title: Quantity field rejects zero and negative values

steps.action: Enter each quantity value for a product

testCases.expectedResult: Values below 1 are rejected; 1 is accepted and added to the cart.
testCases.notes: Minimum quantity rule is not documented. Agree the boundary with the product owner before automating.
